name: lazaretto-plugins
description: Plugins from Lazaretto, a per-call supply-chain scanner for agents. Currently one: an install-path check against published malicious-package advisories.

plugins.name: lazaretto-guard
plugins.description: Before an agent connects a remote MCP server, read the tools it advertises for tool poisoning and hidden orders; before an install, check pinned package versions against published malicious-package advisories. Ask rather than block on anything found. Sends package names and versions, and a remote server's URL with a free key; never a URL that carries a secret. Never blocks, never exits non-zero.
